notes.title: Fallen Sky Online [Rebild] v1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
Fall Sky Online Rebuild version 1.0

Hello survivors!
Today I managed to get Fallen Sky Online (Rebuild) out.
It is still far from finished on version 1, ready in the sense that I will continue to add new content over the months to give you even more game fun!
But this version is the basic version of the game.

In the past few months I have taken the new Intersect engine to completely redesign FSO.
Sure, a lot seems to look the same, but if you take a closer look at the game you will notice the new features more closely;)

e.g. the new HUD or the map names on the HUD or the crafting system.

notes.title: Weapon Update
notes.notes:
There was a weapon update today.
There are now 25 different weapons divided into 7 categories.
There are:

HFW -> small arms
MP -> submachine guns
STG -> assault Rifles
SSG -> sniper Rifles
LMG -> Light machine guns
SF -> shotguns
PW -> plasma Rifles

Meanwhile, the residents of Bad Kreuznach have rebuilt their marketplace and made it more Beautiful designed.

notes.title: Questhelper Update
notes.notes:
Hello dear badlands,

After a few days of work I finally managed to implement Questhelper.
Thanks to Nyuu for reporting;)

The questelper are arrows that indicate the approximate direction to your quest targets.
They will only appear if I have to go to an assignment and not if you have to go back to the quest giver.
There are also no quest tokens if you are in a dungeon like (The Camp, Pennington Ltc., Pinewood LLC or Vault 22).
I decided that to challenge you a little in the Bad Kreuznach wasteland.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33715446/cec1c1d1c4a429e92bafdee415e60697415e8769.png


I also fixed some walking data.



Changes:

-> Add questhelper
-> Change walking data Bad Kreuznach
-> Delete Pinklady Bazaar


What's next?

The next step is to integrate projectiles for weapons into the game.
Also a crafting system and the harvesting System


~ Marco
